lead.t: If a neonate is born to a mother with TB,(congenital tuberculosis) or is exposed to a close contact with TB, Isoniazid Preventive Therapy (IPT) should be given for 6 months once TB disease has been ruled out.\n2 weeks after completion of IPT, give BCG.

snip.t: If a neonate is born to a mother with TB,(congenital tuberculosis) or is exposed to a close contact with TB, Isoniazid Preventive Therapy (IPT) should be given for 6 months once TB disease has been ruled out.\n2 weeks after completion of IPT, give BCG.
Isoniazid Preventive Therapy (IPT): For HIV-positive individuals, children <5 years in contact with active TB, and other high-risk groups.
| TB (LTBI) | All HIV-positive (rule out active TB first) | Isoniazid Preventive Therapy (IPT) × 6 months + pyridoxine |
